$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that WhatsApp Cloud API phone-number health is now synced automatically on a schedule, about every six hours, through low-priority background jobs.
Says that the Account Health page is expanded into sections showing phone, health and capacity, business account, webhook and coexistence details.
Says that the latest health snapshot, check time and last error are stored on the WhatsApp channel record via new columns.
Says that a failed refresh keeps the last successful health data and only records the error and attempt time.
Says that authorization failures are classified and the page directs admins to the Configuration tab, with different wording for Embedded Signup versus manual token.
Says that the health service fetches phone number data and WhatsApp business account data from Meta's Graph API, enforcing a minimum API version.
Does not claim that this change sends notifications or alerts, throttles sending, or automatically disables inboxes when a number becomes unhealthy.
Does not claim that the page shows Meta error codes or stale cached health data to the user when authorization fails.
